plotEn:
Children of the Monkey (Italian: I figli della scimmia) is a 2026 Italian drama film directed by Tommaso Landucci, in his feature directorial debut, and co-written with Damiano Femfert. It stars Riccardo Scamarcio, Fausto Russo Alesi, Lidiya Liberman, Cristina Odasso, and Tancredi Naldini.
